pages.title: WHAT'S WRONG?
pages.creator: Slele
pages.description: Look for things that don't belong in WHAT'S WRONG? Each picture hides strange or impossible details, and you'll need to click or tap every required one to move on. Check the background as well as the obvious objects. There are 60 scenes to investigate, with hints available when a detail escapes you.

pages.title: Hole Puzzle
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: In Hole Puzzle, a hungry cat has a black hole for a mouth. Drag the cat through each level and steer it over the food on your list before time expires. Eating makes the cat grow, so start with what's within reach and work toward the remaining targets as you get bigger.

pages.title: Battle Arena
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Build up an army in Battle Arena by training soldiers at your camp and sending them against enemy forces. Battles earn coins that you can spend back at camp. Decide when to invest in the camp and when to add soldiers so your force can take on the next fight.

pages.title: Winter Wonderland Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Match pairs of penguins, snowflakes, and other winter designs in Winter Wonderland Mahjong. Choose identical tiles that each have an open side, then see what the pair reveals when it comes off the board. A hint, shuffle, or undo can help with a stubborn layout. Play through more boards to unlock backgrounds and tile designs.

pages.title: Island Puzzle: Build & Solve
pages.creator: AnonyMonkeys
pages.description: The numbers beside the island grid in Island Puzzle: Build & Solve tell you how many buildings each row and column still needs. Tap a square to place a building and see how the placement changes both counts. Use the clues together to finish the grid, since a square that fits its row also has to fit its column.

pages.title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Find pairs of runes, potions, and enchanted artifacts in Magic and Wizards Mahjong. Each layout changes which tiles you can get to first, and a quick clear can earn a time bonus. Use Hint or Shuffle to get moving again, or reach for Freeze when the clock is getting in the way.

pages.title: Rock Crawling
pages.creator: StoreRider
pages.description: Take a 4x4 over rocky ridges and muddy tracks in Rock Crawling. Hold the mouse button or space bar to drive, and let up when a change in terrain calls for a slower approach. Watch the slope ahead so you can judge when to keep the power on and when to ease off.

pages.title: Farm Defense
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Mutants are coming out of burrows in Farm Defense. Use the arrow keys or swipe to move between lanes and shoot them before they cross the defense line. Spend coins between waves on improvements such as damage or fire rate, and prepare for tougher enemies as you get farther into the defense.

pages.title: Tricky Challenges: Mini Games
pages.creator: Welwise Studio
pages.description: Tricky Challenges: Mini Games jumps between short tests of reflexes, accuracy, and puzzle solving. Read the tip at the start of each level, then tap to try the new challenge. The instructions change with the activity, so check what the game is asking you to do before relying on the timing that worked in the last round.

pages.title: Dudu Engineering Truck
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Build a work vehicle from shapes in Dudu Engineering Truck, then take it out on the job. Click or tap to assemble the pieces and use the finished truck to complete tasks on the worksite. Look at how the pieces fit before you drive, since construction is part of the challenge.

pages.title: Easter Style Junction Egg Hunt Extravaganza
pages.creator: CGSpot
pages.description: Choose one of four rabbits for the festivities in Easter Style Junction Egg Hunt Extravaganza. Pick outfits and accessories for the dress-up competition, then switch to the Egg Catch Challenge. You can spend time putting together a look before taking on the part of the celebration that tests your timing.

pages.title: Graduation Makeup Trends
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style three friends for their ceremony in Graduation Makeup Trends. Use the mouse to try makeup, then see how your choices look with floral dresses, gold jewelry, or holographic accessories. Each friend has a different style, so a look that suits one girl can give you ideas for a different combination on the next.

pages.title: Kitkat Puzzle
pages.creator: Tiny Castle Studio
pages.description: Work out which chocolate bar can come loose first in Kitkat Puzzle. Use the mouse to remove the bars from the board, keeping an eye on what holds each one in place. Plan the sequence as you go, since clearing one bar can open up the move you need for another.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot: Puzzle & Battle
pages.creator: BOLD CAT
pages.description: Put together portraits of meme characters in Italian Brainrot: Puzzle & Battle. Drag the picture fragments up from the bottom of the screen and fit them into their places. Look at where the shapes and colors meet as you work. Each completed picture brings you closer to unlocking the full lineup.

pages.title: Roblox Craft Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Run along blocky platforms in Roblox Craft Run, where the course leads across bridges and into a maze. Click or tap to play and time each jump to carry your runner over the gaps. Look ahead as you approach the end of a platform so you can line up the next landing.

pages.title: Hole And Fill Collect Master
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Sweep up cakes, meat, and doughnuts in Hole And Fill Collect Master. Steer a moving hole across each scene and gather whatever food you can fit inside it. Larger pieces help you upgrade faster, so work your way through the smaller items until you can swallow more of what's on the map.

pages.title: Steampunk Tower Builder
pages.creator: GamesdMurdock
pages.description: A crane swings the next floor over your stack in Steampunk Tower Builder. Click when it lines up with the floor below, and keep the tower as straight as you can while it climbs. A floor that falls ends the attempt. Try again with a steadier rhythm to reach a higher place on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Daily Wordler
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guess the hidden word in Daily Wordler by entering valid words and reading the colors that come back. A blue tile means you've found a letter and its place. A yellow tile means the letter belongs somewhere else. Use both clues on your next guess, keeping the confirmed positions while testing new letters.

pages.title: Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Explore dungeons in Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures, a 2D platformer where zombies and drones stand between you and the friends you're trying to rescue. Fight your way through the rooms and upgrade your weapons as you go. Look beyond the immediate route when you can, since the dungeon also hides secrets.

pages.title: Vault Breaker
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Help a raccoon crack a safe in Vault Breaker. Watch the red marker circle the door, then click when it passes over the gold button. The vault opens only if you get the timing right, so watch how quickly the marker moves before trying to reach the treasure.

pages.title: Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz
pages.creator: Elraverse
pages.description: Build a stronger tank force in Tanks Merge: Tank War Blitz. Pair identical tanks to turn them into a more powerful unit, then arrange your lineup before going into battle. Keep improving the fleet as you face tougher opponents. The bosses give you a reason to keep working on both the lineup and the tanks in it.

pages.title: Angry Flappy
pages.creator: GLassyStudio
pages.description: Keep your bird in the air in Angry Flappy while firing at enemies and barriers. Tap to flap and adjust your height as the next obstacle approaches. A shot can clear something in your path, but you'll still need to steer around anything that survives. Try to stay airborne as long as you can.

pages.title: Star Attack 3D
pages.creator: Geektales Games ltd
pages.description: Steer a spaceship through formations of numbered alien blocks in Star Attack 3D. Your ship fires automatically, so move sideways to pick a target and avoid collisions. Lower numbers take fewer shots, making them good places to open a route. Upgrade the ship as you take on later levels.

pages.title: OMG Word Sushi
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Trace a path through letters to find hidden words in OMG Word Sushi. The sushi-themed boards put the letters in front of you, and it's up to you to see how they fit together. Try different starting letters when a word is hard to spot. Later levels give your vocabulary more of a workout.

pages.title: Merge Rush Z
pages.creator: PotatoPlay
pages.description: Combine guns to arm your squad in Merge Rush Z. Take those weapons into battles against waves of zombies, then adjust your firing when faster enemies or bigger threats close in. Use the onscreen buttons to control your fire and build up stronger weapons before you face the bosses.

pages.title: Sniper vs Sniper
pages.creator: Berezka
pages.description: Face a rival marksman across the map in Sniper vs Sniper. Use WASD to reposition, hold the right mouse button to aim, and use the left button to fire. Space lets you jump as you move. Look for a clear shot and be ready to relocate when the other sniper has a good angle on you.

pages.title: Mahjong Match Club
pages.creator: 猰貐
pages.description: Clear identical tiles in Mahjong Match Club by pairing them directly or sliding one into position. After a match, look for the green area that shows where a tile can move. Line it up with a twin across an unobstructed row or column, then let go to clear the pair and earn points.

pages.title: Billion Marble
pages.creator: BUSIDOL
pages.description: Roll three dice and buy property in Billion Marble. Move to the space your roll gives you and decide whether the land is worth purchasing. Think about how the purchase fits into the rest of your holdings as you try to gain control of the board. The roll gives you the opportunity, and the purchase is your decision.

pages.title: Help The Kitten
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: Guide a kitten through a series of pin puzzles to rescue its mother in Help The Kitten. Click or tap to move pins and other objects, and think about what each change will open up before making it. Earn coins along the way and spend them on new outfits for the kitten.

pages.title: Tower Defense Zombies
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Buy towers and defend against the undead in Tower Defense Zombies. Use the coins you collect to add more towers or open space for them. Merge towers to make them stronger and faster, and use boosters when the current defenses need help. Keep building as the zombie waves get harder to stop.

pages.title: Solitaire Shuffle
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Build four suit piles from ace to king in Solitaire Shuffle. On the board, arrange cards in descending order and alternate red and black to uncover cards you need. Choose one-card or three-card draws before playing and use hints when you're stuck. The round gives you a limited number of moves to finish.

pages.title: Candy Match
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Travel through a candy world with Ginger in Candy Match. Swap sweets to make groups of the same color and work toward the current level goal. Matches of more than three can create power-ups, so look for those opportunities before making a smaller move. Daily missions and challenges offer more chances to earn coins.

pages.title: Christmas Memory Match
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Turn over two tiles at a time in Christmas Memory Match. Matching holiday pictures disappear and add to your score. If the pictures differ, try to remember where each one was before turning over a new pair. The timer keeps counting down, so use what you've seen to clear pairs quickly.

pages.title: Sort Them Bubbles
pages.creator: HyHyGames
pages.description: Move colored balls between tubes in Sort Them Bubbles until each tube holds a single color. Tap a ball to pick it up, then choose a tube to receive it. Look ahead before filling spare space, since you may need room to move another color. A skip option is available if you get stuck.

pages.title: Word Holiday
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Connect letters to uncover words in Word Holiday. Each board has a set of hidden answers, and you'll need to find the full set before you move on. Try reading the letters from a different starting point when an answer eludes you. Solving boards takes you through new travel locations.

pages.title: Fruitways Matching
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Line up three identical pieces of fruit in Fruitways Matching. Select a fruit and an empty square to move it, provided there's a clear route between them. Aim for a row or column in as few moves as possible before your score runs down. A bomb can help open up space.

pages.title: Targets Attack
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Take aim at the bullseye in Targets Attack. Use the mouse to shoot arrows, and line up each attempt before you commit. Your lives limit how long you can keep shooting, so watch where the last arrow landed as you try to improve your score and hit the center.

pages.title: Idle Fashion Shop
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Open a clothing store in Idle Fashion Shop and handle the floor and checkout yourself at first. Slide to move between jobs and put the money you earn back into the shop. Once you can afford staff, hire sales clerks and cashiers, then look at expanding into other stores such as shoes or lingerie.

pages.title: Guns and Magic
pages.creator: justaliendev
pages.description: Defend your ranch from creatures coming through a portal in Guns and Magic. Move with WASD and aim and shoot with the mouse. Press E to build or upgrade defenses, from barricades to turrets and traps. Use the space the defenses buy you to deal with creatures that make it through.

pages.title: Pretty Avatar Maker
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Make a cartoon portrait in Pretty Avatar Maker. Change facial features, hair, eyes, and lips, then see how different jewelry or accessories work with your choices. Use the random option for a starting point if you'd like to explore. Save the finished portrait as a PNG when you have a look you want to keep.

pages.title: Life of ocean Queen
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Look after the queen's pet in Life of ocean Queen, then help the queen get ready. Use the mouse to work through pet care and switch to her makeover when you're done. Try a face-art design and pick an outfit and accessories that go with it.

pages.title: Rally Champ
pages.creator: Mobile games hub
pages.description: Race for the championship in Rally Champ. Steer left and right around opponents, use boosts through the winding course, and pick up coins as you go. Spend the coins on upgrades before the next event. Keep an eye on the road ahead as you choose where to pass.

pages.title: Bubble Popper
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Tap groups of bubbles to clear them in Bubble Popper. Each board gives you a different arrangement to work with, so scan for a sizable group before you pop it and look again after the board changes. Work through the levels and see how high you can push your score.

pages.title: Classic Nonogram
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Fill squares to reveal a picture in Classic Nonogram. Read the numbers beside each row and column to work out which cells belong to a filled run. Cross-check the two directions before tapping a square. With only three lives, it's worth solving the most certain parts of the grid first.

pages.title: Rocket Race Highway
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Guide a rocket down a busy route in Rocket Race Highway. Use the mouse or touchscreen to move through the stream of pickups and obstacles. Look ahead before you move toward a bonus, since grabbing it can put the rocket in the way of the next hazard.

pages.title: Type Or Die
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Type answers to climb ahead of your rivals in Type Or Die. Each checkpoint asks for a word in a category such as fruit or countries, and every answer in that level begins with the same letter. Enter a valid word quickly so you can keep climbing before the flood reaches you.

pages.title: Race Masters Rush
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Race past motorcyclists and drones in Race Masters Rush. Shoot at enemies in your path and steer around obstacles while collecting items that can improve speed, shielding, or ammunition. Use the arrow keys or WASD to move, or the onscreen buttons on a touchscreen. See how far you can get through the chase.

pages.title: Shot Gems
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Fire gems into the empty spots in Shot Gems. Each spot takes ten gems to fill, and the supply is shared across your attempts to clear levels. Tap to shoot and work out when an obstacle should be avoided and when it can help you get a gem into a spot you can't reach directly.

pages.title: Summer Beach Girl
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Zendaya choose what to wear to the beach in Summer Beach Girl. Browse the swimwear with a mouse or touchscreen, and try different looks before settling on one for the day. Compare how the pieces look as you change them and see which combination best fits your beach outing.

pages.title: Motocross Hero
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Take a dirt bike across the desert in Motocross Hero. Look for potholes and cracks as you race alongside other riders. Use your rear wheel to knock a rival out when you get close enough, then get back onto a clear line before the next hazard crosses your path.

pages.title: Fly THIS!
pages.creator: Northplay
pages.description: Draw flight paths in Fly THIS! to get passengers to their destinations safely. Select a plane and drag out a route, then check how it crosses the paths you've already assigned. Keep aircraft apart as traffic picks up and the clock runs down. Upgrade the airport and add planes as your airline grows.

pages.title: Angry Sharks
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Eat smaller fish to grow in Angry Sharks. Guide the shark with the mouse or your finger and watch for larger or spiny fish as well as mines and spears. Look for a meal you can reach without crossing a hazard. Reach the target size to clear the level and move on.

pages.title: F1 Racing
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Customize a formula car and compete against computer-controlled drivers in F1 Racing. Steer with the arrow keys and press space for a boost when you've got room to use it. Work through the race levels and look for openings to pass the pack and finish in first place.

pages.title: RPS Exclusive
pages.creator: Happy Kid Games
pages.description: Play rock, paper, scissors against a friend or the computer in RPS Exclusive. Rock beats scissors, scissors beat paper, and paper beats rock. In a two-player match, one player picks with A, S, or D and the other uses the left, down, or right arrow. Choose your move and see how it fares against theirs.

pages.title: Seasons
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Pick the picture that fits the season in Seasons. Look for clues in each illustration and decide which one belongs to the time of year the game shows you. Click the image when you have an answer. Each choice gives you practice distinguishing spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

pages.title: Draw Climber Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Give your racing block a leg by drawing one in Draw Climber Online. See how the shape moves your block and redraw it whenever the terrain changes. A leg that works on a flat stretch may struggle at the next obstacle. Keep adapting as you try to finish ahead of the other block.

pages.title: Mia Medical Emergency
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Princess Mia recover from a car accident in Mia Medical Emergency. Use the mouse to work through the treatment and care for her injuries. Once the medical tasks are finished, switch to the wardrobe and choose an outfit for Mia to wear after her checkup.

pages.title: Dangerous Spikes
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Switch between the inner and outer sides of a circle in Dangerous Spikes. Tap when a spike comes up on your side, and check where the next one is before changing again. The challenge is to keep moving around the ring without hitting a spike. Wait for a clear opening before switching sides.

pages.title: Real Rickshaw Drive
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Pick up passengers and drive them to their stops in Real Rickshaw Drive. Use the arrow keys to steer the auto rickshaw through city traffic and handle hill roads on the mountain routes. Leave enough room to turn and slow down as you approach each stop.

pages.title: Prisoner escape jail Break
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Take on a series of breakout missions in Prisoner escape jail Break. You play a mutant superhero trying to make it out of prison. Use the keyboard, including the arrow keys, to move through each mission. Watch the route ahead as you look for a way out.

pages.title: Defeat the monster
pages.creator: Xpresate Studio
pages.description: Pick the right weapon before time runs out in Defeat the monster. Each encounter gives you three choices, and you need to tap the one that works against the creature on screen. Make the decision quickly and look at the new options as soon as the next monster appears.

pages.title: Fashion Blogger
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Put together a look and take selfies in Fashion Blogger. Use the mouse to try outfits, makeup, and hairstyles before stepping in front of the camera. See how your choices come together in a photo shoot, then enter the selfie contest to put your styling choices to the test.

pages.title: Tank Shooter
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Hold off planes and falling bombs in Tank Shooter. Tap to play and keep your tank going while you shoot down threats from above. Watch for supply boxes dropped by a friendly cargo plane. Pick them up to get extra lives, shields, or rockets that help you last through the attack.

pages.title: SkyKid Mini
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fly a small plane past obstacles in SkyKid Mini. Press W, the up arrow, or the left mouse button to make the plane rise. Watch your height as you go and collect stars where you can reach them safely. Save those stars to buy other aircraft for later flights.

pages.title: Sea Fishing
pages.creator: Best Kids Games
pages.description: Lower a hook into the sea and catch fish in Sea Fishing. Click or tap to fish and pay attention to what swims near the hook. Avoid reeling in sharks as you build your catch. The action speeds up over time, leaving less room to wait for the fish you want.

pages.title: Amazing Superheroes Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Choose from eight superhero pictures in Amazing Superheroes Coloring. Click or tap to color the outlines with a palette of 23 shades. Try to finish quickly if you're going for a higher score, or spend time choosing the colors you want. You can save your finished image afterward.

pages.title: Cartoon Kart Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble pictures of cartoon karts in Cartoon Kart Puzzle. Choose from six illustrations and set the puzzle to 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the mouse to fit the pieces together. Start with edges or a distinctive patch of color when the larger layouts make it harder to find a match.

pages.title: Spin The Lucky Wheel Spin and Win 2020
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Give the spinner a turn in Spin The Lucky Wheel and see which numbered segment comes up. Make a prediction before the wheel stops, then compare it with the result. Try another spin or switch to a different wheel design to change how the spinner looks.

pages.title: Detective Photo Difference Game
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Compare two photos to find what's changed in Detective Photo Difference Game. Work through one area of the pictures at a time, looking for a detail that's missing or different in the other photo. Use the mouse to select each difference when you spot it.

pages.title: Beetlie Car Parking
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Drive a Beetle along zigzag tracks and ramps above the water in Beetlie Car Parking. Use WASD or the arrow keys to stay on the elevated route and reach the parking spot. Keep the car lined up before a jump and slow down when the track turns sharply.

pages.title: Commando Girl
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take on combat missions in Commando Girl. Move with WASD, aim and fire with the mouse, and use F to pick up a weapon. You can crouch with Z, go prone with X, and switch to a first-person view with C. Try either game mode as you work through the missions.

pages.title: SamUp
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Guide a flying character upward in SamUp. Click to move the player and keep an eye on what lies directly above as the screen climbs. See how far you can keep the run going, then compare the result with your best score and try to beat it.

pages.title: Top Boat Water Jet Sky Simulator Racing 3D
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take a watercraft into competition in Top Boat Water Jet Sky Simulator Racing 3D. Choose a ride in the garage and race other craft, using nitro when you need an extra burst of speed. After a race, look through the upgrades for improvements to speed, handling, or braking before heading back out.

pages.title: Ana Jones
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Lead Ana through ancient ruins in Ana Jones. Tap to jump over traps and drops as you hunt for a golden skull, and pick up precious stones when you can reach them safely. Keep watching the route ahead so Ana can collect the treasure and make it out of the site.

pages.title: Sweet Home Cleaning : Princess House Cleanup Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Tidy up one room at a time in Sweet Home Cleaning : Princess House Cleanup Game. Straighten the bed and linens, deal with food messes and broken items in the kitchen, and clean the bathroom tiles and mirrors. Check what needs attention in each room as you work through the house.

pages.title: SnowHeroes.io
pages.creator: NIGHT STEED S.C.
pages.description: Roll around the arena collecting orbs in SnowHeroes.io. Guide your snowball with the cursor and use the mouse buttons to sprint or jump. Sprinting costs mass, so save it for a move that counts. Once you're bigger, try landing a jump on a smaller snowball to gain the upper hand.

pages.title: Little Restaurant Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find seven differences in each pair of restaurant pictures in Little Restaurant Difference. Click or tap the details that have changed, and keep checking the areas you haven't scanned. You get one minute per level, so move on to another part of the picture if a difference is taking too long to find.

pages.title: Balls Rotate 3D
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Roll a ball along a track in Balls Rotate 3D. Use the mouse to send it forward, and time its movement so it can cross the platforms without hitting the red blocks. Watch the obstacle ahead of you and wait for an opening before rolling on to the finish.

pages.title: Cooking Fast Halloween
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Serve Halloween dishes in Cooking Fast Halloween. Click ingredients to put them in the pan and click the plates to send finished orders to customers. Get the mummy hot dogs and pizza pies out as orders come in. Visit the cooking shop to upgrade your pans or buy more plates.

pages.title: Mini John Cooper Works Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put together pictures of the Mini John Cooper Works in Mini John Cooper Works Puzzle. Pick one of six images and decide whether to solve it with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the mouse to place pieces, and look for edges or recognizable car details to anchor the harder layouts.

pages.title: Car Driving Stunt Game
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Pick a car in Car Driving Stunt Game and look for ramps across the city and surrounding terrain. Use the arrow keys to steer, accelerate, and brake as you line up a jump. Collect gems while you explore to unlock more vehicles and try the ramps in a different car.

pages.title: Forest Survival Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Survive a plane crash in Forest Survival Simulator. Explore the forest for food and a place to shelter while staying alert to hostile inhabitants. Decide when to search farther from safety and when to prepare to defend yourself. Check the in-game help menu for the controls before heading deeper into the woods.

pages.title: Public Tricycle Rickshaw Driving
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Take a cycle rickshaw through driving challenges in Public Tricycle Rickshaw Driving. Use WASD to guide it along the road, and give the three-wheeler room to turn when the route changes direction. Work through the levels and see how the rickshaw handles as the road ahead changes.

pages.title: Bottle Rush
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Flip a bottle across a room in Bottle Rush. Click or tap to send it up and aim to land on books, other bottles, or even a moving robot vacuum. Time the next flip from wherever the bottle settles. Keep it from hitting the floor as you work through the 30 levels.

pages.title: Arcade Hoops
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Score as many baskets as you can in 45 seconds in Arcade Hoops. Shoot with the mouse and lead the moving hoop as it slides from side to side. Watch where your last ball went before taking another shot. Collect coins to unlock other basketball designs.

pages.title: Guess How Many
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Count the animals on screen in Guess How Many and select the matching number below them. The timer gives you only a short window to count and choose. Try scanning from one side to the other so you can keep track of the animals you've already counted.

pages.title: Jewel Block
pages.creator: The Walking Fish
pages.description: Fit jewel shapes into open cells in Jewel Block. Drag a piece onto the grid to fill part of a row or column. A full line clears and makes room for more pieces. Leave space for awkward shapes while you're deciding where to place the current block.

pages.title: Sound Guess
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Listen to a mystery sound in Sound Guess and use the letters on screen to spell what you think made it. Press the large sound button when you're ready to listen. Match what you heard to a word you can build from the given letters.

pages.title: Tank Rumble
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take a tank into a split-screen match in Tank Rumble. Challenge a friend, fight the computer, or team up against it. Choose an open or maze map and pick Survival or Deathmatch. One player drives with WASD and fires with G, while the other uses the arrow keys and L.

pages.title: Pizza Challenge
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Grab pizza slices as they come around the table in Pizza Challenge. Press your grab key when a slice is right in front of you, and try to take five before the other player does. Play against the computer or share a keyboard with a friend using W and the up arrow.

pages.title: 1010! Block Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Place shapes on the grid in 1010! Block Puzzle and try to fill entire rows or columns. Each complete line disappears and gives you room to work with the next pieces. There's no timer, so compare possible placements before committing and leave room for shapes that span several cells.

pages.title: Baseball kid Pitcher cup
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Pitch against 20 opposing teams in Baseball kid Pitcher cup. Read the number prompt and use the numbered circle to enter the sequence before the timer expires. Get the numbers right to deliver the pitch, then check the scoreboard above the catcher as you try to lead your team to a win.

pages.title: Forest Lake
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Cast a line in Forest Lake and try different baits for fish such as perch, pike, and bream. Move the mouse to aim the rod and see what bites at your chosen spot. The game tracks the weight of your catch, and catching more fish opens up new places to try.

pages.title: Adam and Eve: Zombies
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Help Adam get past cats that have turned into zombies in Adam and Eve: Zombies. Click or tap objects in each scene to see what they do, and work out how to open a route forward. Look around before moving on, since an object nearby can be part of the solution.

pages.title: Underwater Make up Salon
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Give a mermaid princess a makeover in Underwater Make up Salon. Try the makeup available at the salon, then look through the dresses for a color or style that fits. Compare the whole look as you change pieces and choose what she'll wear when the makeover is done.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Vaccines Injection
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Guide Dotted Girl through a checkup and her scheduled shots in Dotted Girl Vaccines Injection. Tap through the steps to take her temperature and check her heartbeat. Prepare the injection site, give the shot, and clean the area afterward. Repeat the checkup when the game moves to her next vaccination.

pages.title: Galaxy Commander
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Protect your starbase and launch a counterattack in Galaxy Commander. Spend resources to deploy ships against the alien fleet. Some craft fight at close range, while others can attack from farther away. Pick the right mix to intercept incoming ships and break through to the enemy base.

pages.title: Orc Shooter
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Help Franky clear out orcs in Orc Shooter. Aim the bazooka with the mouse and use the dotted guide to judge where the explosive shot will go. Work around blocks that stand between you and the targets. Clear the orcs in the current setup to open the next level.

pages.title: Vex 3
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Run, jump, and slide through the trap-filled courses in Vex 3. Use WASD or the arrow keys and watch the timing of each obstacle before you cross it. Reach the finish to open the next area, or try the challenge modes when you're ready to test your movement under tougher conditions.

pages.title: Rosalie Fashion Day
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Help Rosalie find her missing belongings in Rosalie Fashion Day. Search for the items first, then move on to the wardrobe and choose what she'll wear out. Try a dress or pair a blouse with jeans, and finish your look with a bag and shoes.
